releaseNotes: Synchronised the first-launch splash with completion of verified offline setup; the splash timer no longer runs behind the installer.
Waited for every deferred application script before rendering onboarding, so the first launch uses the current hologram renderer.
Disabled the legacy intro screen through a reversible iOS feature switch; the original renderer remains available as a backup.
Removed activation-time forced page navigation and user-facing/manual reload update behavior.
